actual: MA-E19R had 12 configured serial loops. backend-main restarted at 11:00:22 while Loop3 was active; Loop3 callback completed at 11:02:55, but the new process retained task status=running with submitted_loop_count=3 and never submitted Loop4. Node remained healthy and idle, resume_allowed=true, and no running loop existed. Require startup/reconciliation recovery to resume exactly once from the first unsubmitted custom-evo loop, preserve completed loops, avoid duplicate submissions, and fail closed on ambiguous active-loop state.
